what: Plan adds `--preview-only` but does not require the preview branch to terminate before the existing `--round-cap` requirement and review driver body
scenario_or_breakage: `run-step3-review.sh --preview-only --design-tmpdir "$TMP"` (as in the planned harness) still hits `[[ -n "$ROUND_CAP" ]] || fail '--round-cap is required'` at lines 46-47 and exits 2, so the live preview fence prints nothing and Step 3 never reaches review
suggested_fix: After handling preview capture/emit/sentinel touch, end the `--preview-only` branch with `exit 0` before `--round-cap` validation, tmpdir `cd`, cap guard, `plan-review-loop.sh`, and `.step3-review-result.env` writes
